name: Sylvie
source:
A little orphan who was enslaved by a cruel man. Her body is full of scars from abuse and torture to which she was subjected for years; the former owner only abused her physically, for some strange reason she was never raped.

She is given to protagonist by Ferrum, initially she expected to be subjected to torture but instead, she receives something new in her life... love.
